verdict.rationale: Skyfire documents an official hosted MCP server (https://mcp.skyfire.xyz/mcp, plus sandbox) with documented tools (find-sellers, create-kya-token, create-pay-token, create-kya-payment-token) and auth via API key header, letting agents connect and execute commerce workflows. missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration of the MCP server working in practice, and no public OpenAPI/schema for deeper verification.
